text: You are going to investigate what happens when nitric acid reacts with aqueous solutions of two
different alkalis, solution N and solution O.
Read all the instructions carefully before starting the experiments.
Instructions
You are going to carry out two experiments.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the appearance of solid P.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Use a spatula to divide solid P into three portions.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
test 1
Heat the first portion of solid P in a hard-glass test-tube.
Test any gases given off with cobalt(II) chloride paper.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
test 2
Carry out a flame test on the second portion of solid P.
Record your observations.

tests on a solution of P
Add about 10cm of distilled water to the third portion of solid P in a test-tube. Stopper the test-tube
and shake it to dissolve solid P.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Divide the solution into four equal portions in four test-tubes. Carry out the following tests.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
To the first portion of the solution, add several drops of aqueous sodium hydroxide.
Then add excess aqueous sodium hydroxide to the mixture.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
To the second portion of the solution, add excess aqueous ammonia.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
To the third portion of the solution, add a few drops of dilute nitric acid and about 1cm of
aqueous silver nitrate.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (iv)
parts.text:
To the fourth portion of the solution, add a few drops of dilute nitric acid and about 1cm of
aqueous barium nitrate.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Solid P contains a metal ion.
Suggest what the appearance of solid P in (a) tells you about the identity of the metal ion.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: What does test 1 tell you about solid P?

parts.label: (f)
parts.text: What does test 2 tell you about solid P?

parts.label: (g)
parts.text: Identify solid P.

text: You are provided with solid P, which is a metallic salt.
Carry out the following tests on solid P, recording all of your observations at each stage.

Agri Limes are mixtures of calcium carbonate and calcium oxide. Farmers use Agri Limes on fields
to neutralise acidity.
Plan an investigation to find out which of two different Agri Limes, Q or R, will neutralise more acid.
